projectRolePredicates.description: Top-level /tmp basenames tied to @ak/pi-workflow-roles Judge/Fixer/Coder/Reviewer/Collector development and issue #1–#3 work.
excludeNotes: issue10/issue-10 scratch is out of Case A five-role/#1–#3 denominator (issue #10 had its own migration).
Other-project trees (issue33+, issue39+, ak-rm-*, xcresult) do not match prefixes.
No recursion into subdirectories; directory entries are outside the file inventory.

cutoff.description: Inventory is the set of matching top-level entries present at construction walk start. No mtime lower bound. Volatility after walk start is out of universe.

digestPolicy.regularFileNonGeneric: sha256 of exact rescued bytes after no-follow open; verified copy-then-hash
digestPolicy.regularFileGenericExhaust: sha256 of exact source bytes for inventory identity only; payload not semantically parsed; bytes never copied into Git

stableItemKey.description: Stable across re-runs on identical inode snapshot; not a path-only key.

role-session-recording.function: raw Pi/role invocation event stream captured by orchestrator
role-session-recording.provenance: basename matches project/role predicates AND ends with .jsonl AND matches role-invocation capture naming used by this package's historical runner (contains role/phase tokens or dogfood/session capture shape)

build-test-pack-output.function: build, test, typecheck, pack, or CLI stdout/stderr exhaust
build-test-pack-output.provenance: basename matches known exhaust suffixes/tokens (.log/.out/.err/.tap, typecheck, test.txt, commits.txt, pack.txt, pack-*.txt, stderr, install.log, live-help dump)

ephemeral-cli-scratch.function: path export, nl probe, work-ready marker, or empty scratch
ephemeral-cli-scratch.provenance: basename matches judge-nl/reviewer-nl/export/work-r/r-ready/r-block/rerecord scratch tokens or zero-length non-document

decision-chain-artifact.function: authority, plan, fix packet, typed receipt, review report/task, adjudication, disposition, finding, closure court, corrections, residual, synthesis, or evidence probe that carries the claim chain

genericExhaustClassification.irreducibleExhibitPath: Only when frozen citation/provenance identifies an exact artifact independently of exploratory generic-payload reading; none pre-cited for Case A beyond decision-chain name class. Surrounding generic containers remain metadata-only.

completenessClaim: Coverage is limited to the frozen discoverable universe at walk start under sealed predicates. This migration does not claim historical completeness.
